title: fix(components,plugin-grid): selecting a cell's text neither opens the record nor starts an edit (objectui#13188)
body:
Fixes objectui#13188

## What

Drag-selecting text in a list cell ended in a `click` on the row or cell it started in. On a read-only list that click opened the record; on an editable list (`ObjectGrid` defaults `singleClickEdit` to true) it started an inline edit. Either way the text could not be copied.

- `hasTextSelectionIn(el)`: true when the viewer has a non-empty selection touching `el`. A plain click collapses any earlier selection on mousedown, so it still activates.
- The row's `onClick` skips `onRowClick` when the row holds a selection.
- The cell's single-click and double-click `startEdit` paths skip when the cell holds a selection.
- Ctrl/Cmd+C on a cell with selected text leaves the browser copy alone instead of `preventDefault()` + writing the raw cell value. A masked column still copies nothing (objectui#10583): the mask check runs first.
- `VirtualGrid` row click gets the same selection guard.

Double-click-to-select-a-word on a read-only list is left as is (option B on the issue): no delay on single-click open.

## Tests

New `data-table-textSelection-13188.test.tsx` (10 cases): selection click does not open; plain click opens; a selection in another row does not block; editable single-click and double-click modes do not enter edit on a selection and still do without one; Ctrl+C with a selection is not cancelled; Ctrl+C without one copies the whole value; masked cell copies nothing. 4 of them fail without the fix. All `data-table*` and `plugin-grid` tests pass (2294).

Also checked in a real browser with real mouse drags on a static build: read-only drag selects a partial value and Ctrl+C pastes exactly that partial text; read-only click opens; editable drag does not enter edit; editable click does.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
